Blending alphas can drop correct items out of top-K — prefer >=2.0 when recall@limit matters

rerank_pool.description: Embedding/reorder width for rerank (default 0 = auto: min(50, max(limit, candidate_limit)), capped at 50). Lower it on CPU embedders to cut latency without narrowing candidate_limit (the deterministic retrieval width)
